scope: Technical acceptance of g4-ghost-local for the reviewed local synthetic stack only: proxy routing, selected local assets, application outage isolation, selected regressions and Ghost persistence.
cause: Review the current implementation against ADR 0004 local deployment and acceptance requirements and the four captured evidence records.
decision: PASS the local technical task only. Do not change Gate 2 approval status or treat this as production, publishing-authority, real-user data or live-newsletter approval. Gate prerequisites remain enforced.
observed_result: Reviewed configuration publishes only the loopback proxy port, uses separate community/publication databases and credentials, configures the /news/ canonical URL, and directs local email to logging/Mailpit. Nine verifier tests, 38 frontend tests, type checking and production build passed. Ghost content marker and selected database identities survived replacement of Ghost and its database containers; routing recovered. Supporting evidence snapshots and hashes are embedded.
regression_test: See embedded regression, outage and persistence evidence for executed commands, outputs, container identities and documented limitations.
limitations: Local synthetic stack only; staged source is not yet committed. Known literal database credentials are development-only. Images are tagged rather than digest-pinned; the source fingerprint does not capture all runtime state. No authenticated editorial/member/newsletter acceptance, browser execution, nested asset-import or external CDN validation. No full database-integrity, backup/restore, host-loss or production operational acceptance. Proxy and host remain shared failure points. Same-origin applications are not a browser-origin security boundary. Gates 2 and 5-8 retain their separate requirements. This command assembles a reviewed decision; it does not rerun tests.
